name: A. L. Gustin Golf Course
foot: Automatic page (not hand checked): course from OpenStreetMap, card from golfify, trees / long grass / water from the vision layer on USDA NAIP + USGS 3DEP lidar, OB inferred from the course outline and buildings. Solved tee sets: Black, Gold. See qa_report.md for the hole-by-hole checks.

review.why: Publishable after the hole-15 fix; as-is the hole-15 Black advice is from an imaginary tee.

15: Black tee is a walk-back placed 67 yds behind the OSM hole-way start, in trees on a hillside beside the pond (ground falls 11 ft in the first 20 yds; no flat pad in the lidar, no box in the imagery).
